description: Modbus/TCP, the Sextant protocol showcase: a real industrial protocol with a public specification. Each application data unit is an MBAP header (transaction id, protocol id, length, unit id) followed by a function code and function-specific data. The transaction id is a sequence/transaction field the response echoes, the length is a remaining-length field, and the function code is the message type.

provenance.origin: Synthetic, spec-faithful Modbus/TCP exchange generated by corpus/modbus/generate.py. Not captured from any third-party device or network.
provenance.notes: Modbus is an openly published specification. These packets are authored for the project and carry no third-party data. Safe to redistribute.
